segments.note: COLD OPEN: this predated the iPad, the Palm Pilot, everything. But we missed the boat. Why? Because they didn't know how to commercialise it.
Simputer was the first, world's first handheld multilingual GPRS-connected computer. (old name tag gone at 7.98; 'Yes.' at 17.24 cut)
By the time they, some private company tried to
license it... 40,000 units... too late... iPad took over the market. I told the government: a million of those tablets, (0.9 s silence trimmed)
and it would have been something that even iPad would have licensed. ('economies of scale / ahead of the curve' cut)
